verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a v2 REST API with Bearer and OAuth authentication, an SDK, an MCP server, and internal custom workflows and notifications. None of it describes registrable outbound webhooks or event hooks that fire on user lifecycle or auth events for a programmatic consumer. Internal automations and pull-based REST endpoints are adjacent features and do not satisfy a webhooks story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
